 GTA 6 Live Coverage: News, Reviews, and More
 After 13 years of waiting, GTA 6 is finally out in the US and Canada on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Here’s what you need to know before jumping into Leonida, including when the game unlocked, how long it takes to download, and how PS5 game sharing works.
 By Brent Koepp , Denny Connolly , and Brianne Garbutt 
 November 18, 2026, 5:47pm

 1 day ago / 12:20 PM CST
 GTA 6 Has Multiple Endings and These Four Things Can Change Yours
 If you’re just getting started in Leonida, you might be wondering whether the choices you make early on can change how Jason and Lucia’s story ends. I beat Grand Theft Auto VI for my review and tested what can change the finale. Here are four things that affect which ending you get , without spoiling what happens.
 1 day ago / 11:46 AM CST
 Who Voices Jason and Lucia in GTA 6? Here’s Where You’ve Seen Them Before.
 The cast bringing this game to life features some familiar voices and faces, including Stephen Root of King of the Hill fame as Jason’s boss, and former Saturday Night Live castmate Bobby Moynihan as Cal. But, of course, it’s the actors behind Jason and Lucia who really steal the show. For anyone wondering why the two sound so familiar, here is where you may have seen them before. 1 day ago / 11:12 AM CST
 Can You Cheat on Lucia? Sex and Romance Options Explained
 At the center of Grand Theft Auto VI ’s story is an optional romance between Jason and Lucia. As a result, players who want to cause chaos in Leonida may be wondering what their dating options are. Can you cheat on Lucia? Can Jason date Mandy? Here’s everything you need to know about GTA 6 romance options in Vice City. 1 day ago / 9:30 AM CST
 All GTA 6 Cheat Codes for PS5 and Xbox
 GTA 6 has a total 61 cheats , although not all of them have been unlocked yet. In my Grand Theft Auto VI review playthrough, I managed to get 12 of them through my own progression. We will continue to update this page as we continue grinding out the game to access more of them. 1 day ago / 8:50 AM CST
 Every Radio Station in GTA 6 (and Every Song You Can Hear on Them)
 Scanning through different radio stations while driving around the city has been a staple of the GTA experience for generations and there are now even more ways to interact with music than ever before. Here is a full breakdown of every radio station and all the tracks that we’ve heard or managed to dig up so far. 1 day ago / 2:21 AM CST
 How to Make Money Fast
 Money can be tight at the start of Grand Theft Auto VI , especially when you need cash to progress the story. Here’s how to make money fast in GTA 6 , including where to find your first Illegal Operation and when you can start selling parked cars.
 1 day ago / 1:23 AM CST
 How to Fast Travel and Unlock the RydeMe App
 Grand Theft Auto VI lets you fast travel across Leonida by calling a ride on your phone. Here’s when you unlock the RydeMe app , how to use it, and how much it costs to skip the ride.
 1 day ago / 12:46 AM CST
 All GTA 6 Safe Codes for Chapter 2 in Port Gellhorn
 In Grand Theft Auto VI , players can find safe codes to earn extra cash at Illegal Operations. Here are all three GTA 6 safe codes for Port Gellhorn in Chapter 2, as well as where to find them if you want to unlock the safes yourself.
 1 day ago / 12:00 AM CST
 PS5 Download Size and Game Sharing Explained
 After 13 years of waiting, GTA 6 is finally out in the US and Canada on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Here’s what you need to know before jumping into Leonida, including when the game unlocked, how long it takes to download, and how PS5 game sharing works. 1 day ago / 5:00 PM CST
 How to Unlock GTA 6 Ultimate Edition Content and When Each Bonus Becomes Available
 If you bought the $100 GTA 6 Ultimate Edition and are wondering where your bonuses are, some of them won’t show up until you’ve put dozens of hours into the game. Here’s what GTA 6 Ultimate Edition includes , which chapter unlocks each bonus, and which vehicles you can only use in Chapter 1. 1 day ago / 1:10 PM CST
 GTA 6 Has One Man Booking a Weeklong Vacation From His Own Marriage
 A solo hotel stay is one good way to get alone time, and it allows someone to decompress, to starfish on a big bed and watch TV, and…play GTA 6 with minimal interruptions. One gamer took that idea and ran with it, booking a hotel room for himself right before the game became available worldwide on November 19. 
 2 days ago / 12:25 PM CST
 Rockstar Explains Why GTA 6 Doesn’t Have Prostitutes
 One of Grand Theft Auto’s longest-running features is missing from GTA 6 . Rockstar Games has explained why it dropped the option to hire prostitutes in Grand Theft Auto VI and how Jason and Lucia’s story shaped what made it into Vice City this time around. 
 2 days ago / 10:29 AM CST
 How Cheat Codes Work Differently In Leonida
 GTA 6 has cheat codes, however unlocking them works differently compared to previous Rockstar games according to reports. Here we explain how to reportedly unlock Grand Theft Auto VI cheats in your game to cause chaos in Leonida. 2 days ago / 9:39 AM CST
 Dating in Vice City – How Rockstar Built Jason and Lucia’s Romance
 Grand Theft Auto VI is pushing the boundaries of gaming with groundbreaking features and technical feats that push the limits of modern consoles. However, Rockstar is also creating next-level romance in GTA 6 in a way that’s never been seen before in the series. Jason and Lucia’s relationship is at the center of the next Grand Theft Auto and the seedy underbelly of Vice City. 
 2 days ago / 9:30 AM CST
 PS5 Trophy List Revealed – How Many Trophies Do You Need for Platinum?
 The GTA 6 trophy list has surfaced ahead of the game’s November 19 launch, giving PS5 players an idea of what it’ll take to earn the Platinum. Here’s how many trophies you’ll need to unlock and how long it took me to finish the story for our review. 2 days ago / 7:59 AM CST
 The New Zealand Trick Works on Xbox – But There May Be a Catch On PS5
 The GTA 6 New Zealand trick is reportedly letting Xbox players in the US jump into Vice City early. But claims of PlayStation account suspensions are also circulating, and the method works differently on PS5. Here’s what we know about the early unlock and the reported suspensions. 2 days ago / 6:42 AM CST
 Grand Theft Auto VI Is Now The Highest Rated Game Of All Time
 GTA 6 reviews are out, and critics are calling Rockstar’s return to Vice City worth the 13-year wait. The first wave of PS5 reviews includes 101 perfect scores and rising, with critics praising everything from Leonida’s incredible level of detail to Jason and Lucia’s surprisingly intimate story. Here is our GTA 6 review metacritic roundup . 
 2 days ago / 6:17 AM CST
 When Grand Theft Auto VI Launches Worldwide
 GTA 6 is officially out in New Zealand, and players are now diving into Leonida for the first time. Here’s when Grand Theft Auto VI unlocks in the US and around the world, plus the PS5 update you’ll need before you can play. 
 2 days ago / 6:02 AM CST
 GTA 6 Review – Rockstar’s Magnum Opus
 Grand Theft Auto VI is not only shaping up to be the biggest pop cultural event in gaming history, but in modern media itself. In our review , we break down how a groundbreaking open world and Jason and Lucia’s story make it Rockstar’s best game.
